def factor_price_impact_vol_adjusted_vol_asym(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy['close']
    volume = df_copy['volume']
    high = df_copy['high']
    low = df_copy['low']
    ret = close / close.shift(1) - 1.0
    abs_ret = ret.abs()
    impact = abs_ret / volume.replace(0, np.nan)
    avg_impact = impact.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    vol = ret.rolling(20, min_periods=20).std(ddof=1).replace(0, np.nan)
    base_factor = avg_impact / vol
    pos_ret = ret.where(ret > 0, 0.0)
    neg_ret = ret.where(ret < 0, 0.0)
    window = 60
    vol_up = pos_ret.rolling(window, min_periods=int(window/2)).std(ddof=1)
    vol_down = neg_ret.rolling(window, min_periods=int(window/2)).std(ddof=1)
    vol_ratio = vol_down / vol_up.replace(0, np.nan)
    vol_ratio = vol_ratio.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    smoothed_vol_ratio = vol_ratio.ewm(span=20, min_periods=10).mean()
    factor = base_factor * (1.0 + smoothed_vol_ratio.fillna(0))
    factor = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0)
    df_copy['factor_price_impact_vol_adjusted_vol_asym'] = factor
    return df_copy['factor_price_impact_vol_adjusted_vol_asym']
